The major pathway of rRNA processing in the nucleolus and cytosol

A schematic representation of the major pathway of rRNA processing in the nucleolus and cytosol. Proteins indicated in red were significantly upregulated, while proteins indicated in blue were downregulated in Dox-treated AGS cells compared to control untreated cells. The figure was generated by Qiagen Ingenuity Pathway Analysis (IPA)
